title: Planning around obstacles (PythonRobotics)
description: PythonRobotics runs its original A* planner for three robot radii. Prepared routes are checked against the obstacle clearance used by the planner.
description_ko: PythonRobotics의 원본 A* 계획기를 세 로봇 반지름으로 실행했어요. 계산한 경로가 계획기의 장애물 여유 거리를 지키는지 확인했어요.
prompt: Planning around obstacles. Rerun the included recipe to change simulation inputs.
made_with: numpy==2.2.6, matplotlib==3.11.2; executed locally on macOS arm64
